searchQueries.description: Enter search terms just like you would enter it in YouTube's search bar.

maxResults.description: Limit the number of videos you want to crawl. If you scrape a channel, acts as a limit for regular videos.

maxResultsShorts.description: Limit the number of Shorts videos you want to crawl.

maxResultStreams.description: Limit the number of Stream videos you want to crawl.

startUrls.description: Enter a link to a YouTube video, chann

transcriptionAndSubtitle.description: Choose whether to download subtitles, transcribe the video using speech-to-text AI, or both. Leave empty to skip subtitles and transcription. Subtitles are added to the dataset items, while transcript

subtitlesLanguage.description:
Language to download subtitles in.
Note: a subtitle-downloading option must be selected in Transcription & subtitles for this to work.

subtitlesFormat.description: Select in what format you want to download subtitles

sortingOrder.description: Select Youtube sorting parameter for search

dateFilter.description: Select Youtube upload date filter for search

videoType.description: Select Youtube video type filter for search

lengthFilter.description: Select Youtube video length filter for search

isHD.description: Will apply the HD filter for search

hasSubtitles.description: Will apply the Subtitles/CC filter for search

hasCC.description: Will apply the Creative Commons filter for search

is3D.description: Will apply the 3D filter for search

isLive.description: Will apply the Live filter for search

isBought.description: Will apply the Purchased filter for search

is4K.description: Will apply the 4K filter for search

is360.description: Will apply the 360 degrees filter for search

hasLocation.description: Will apply the Location filter for search

isHDR.description: Will apply the HDR filter for search

isVR180.description: Will apply the VR180 filter for search

oldestPostDate.description: Only posts uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 day will get you only today's posts, 2 days

sortVideosBy.description: Maps to the sorting buttons on the top of the channel's 'Videos', 'Shorts' and 'Live' pages.

aiVideoDescription.description: If enabled, uses AI to generate a time-segmented description of the video, covering both visual and audio content for each segment.

aiVideoSummary.description: If enabled, uses AI to generate a concise conceptual summary of the video covering both visual and audio content.

saveSubsToKVS.description: If set to true, the scraper will save the downloaded subtitles to the key-value store. Transcripts are always saved to the key-value store

preferAutoGeneratedSubtitles.description: If set to true, automatically generated subtitles are preferred to user subtitles. Note: a subtitle language must be selected and a subtitle-downloading option must be selected in Transcript
